'''Rhomby Grammus'''<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> was a [[Gender|female]] [[Lukovel]]<ref name="SWE" /> who lived in [[the galaxy]]. Rhomby and her [[twin]] sister, [[Parallela Grammus]], were both present at the [[Canto Bight]] [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|casino]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref>

A pair of performance artists, the sisters claimed to hail from another dimension and occasionally spoke in what seemed to be an invented language.<ref name="TLJVD" />
